rule: WAITING is line-specific and never means mission IDLE or DONE. Blocked work registers its dependency and the mission continues with the highest-priority non-blocked item.

items.objective: Reconcile current feature-branch state with source-main 15-mission evidence and current Git/PR/CI state.
items.problem: Control-plane documentation and 15-mission source architecture are not yet proven current on the same branch.
items.authorized_action: Inspect current branch, source-main mission architecture, PR #35 and CI; persist explicit source-of-truth reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: No mission claimed operational solely from stale docs
items.validation_method: Git ref/commit inspection + registry validation + CI/PR inspection + persisted reconciliation

items.objective: Implement persistent append-only contribution/state-transition event lineage.
items.problem: Control-plane events are currently validated in memory but not persisted as an executable event log.
items.authorized_action: Design and implement minimal append-only event record compatible with contribution schema and mission transitions.

items.objective: Make zero-context bootstrap execute control-plane validation and replay checks rather than merely describing them.
items.problem: Bootstrap currently validates state but does not yet reconstruct the full multi-mission lifecycle from event/claim/handoff history.
items.authorized_action: Extend bootstrap after event lineage exists to replay mission registry, claims, handoffs and transitions and fail closed on divergence.
acceptance_criteria: fresh instance can reconstruct operational state

items.objective: Inspect existing warning, decision and action consumers before implementing response-coupling ledger functionality.
items.problem: Operational effectiveness requires linking warning, decision, response exposure and outcome ascertainment without duplicating existing contracts.
items.authorized_action: Source-inspect warning/decision/action consumers and existing persistence; produce response-coupling audit and only then implement justified ledger changes.
items.validation_method: source inspection + contract audit + adversarial tests + scientific consistency audit
